purpose: Compile and run all portable focused camera policy and trace tests, including obstruction and slide lifecycle regressions
command: timeout --kill-after=5s 600s bash -c 'set -e; for test in policy_test precision_policy_test precision_trace_test lifecycle_policy_test obstruction_policy_test obstruction_probe_test; do g++ -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -I modules/camera/include modules/camera/tests/$test.cpp -o /tmp/skycrpg-slide-$test; /tmp/skycrpg-slide-$test; done'
expected: all six tests and job exit 0
cleanup: timeout terminates job on deadline; temporary binaries retained in /tmp
